document_title: Quarterly Large Load Economic Development Report, Q2 2025 (period ending June 30, 2025) - Public Disclosure version
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=223705 to read its download link, then downloaded the ZIP from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/223705/104985. Unzipped it and took ONLY the public-disclosure (PD) PDF, deliberately leaving the trade-secret (TS) files in the archive untouched. Converted that PDF to text with pdfminer.six extract_text(). The text is saved exactly as pdfminer emitted it - no reflow, no de-hyphenation, no ligature or soft-hyphen cleanup, form feeds and column artefacts left in place.
